texts: Two checks before a 3D model ships: the catalog gate, and a diff that names what broke

Our catalog turns away a character that arrives as more than 8 meshes, and you can run that exact check on your own .glb without uploading it. The write-up covers the five structural checks, how Model Diff names the joints and clips a change removed, the exit codes for CI, and where its rename detection still guesses wrong: three.ws/inspect

editor.summary: Every claim in the post maps to a passing verification against the live pages or the gate and diff source, including the 8-mesh character limit, the browser-only run, the five checks, named joints and clips, CI exit codes, and the known rename-detection weakness. The post leads on the mechanism, follows the voice contract (no hashtags, emoji, dashes, or hype), keeps the single correct link, and the cover frame plus alt text accurately describe the Model Diff viewer with X Bot beside Michelle.
